method: Barkley Heun/Rusanov/upwind + multiplicative Itô noise as original lab

decay_criteria.event_time: start of persistent quiet episode, retrospectively censored
decay_criteria.important: Missing threshold crossing alone is not a confirmed decay

edge.source: edge-scan/r_0.595714.json (numerical decay edge, nearest scan point)

asymptotic.definition: leading-order slow-interior length, excluding O(1) front widths

root_uncertainty_note: When multiple stable drift zeros occur, a single bootstrap root interval mixes branches and is omitted; coefficient-level ancestor-bootstrap CIs remain valid. Roots are finite-lag, censoring-sensitive measurements.
